newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume dives on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume dives on weak demand.

text.p: Istanbul gold volume slumped to 702 kilos on Friday from 1,744 kilos on Thursday as free market demand faded and players awaited for direction on gold prices from world markets, dealers said.
Gold closed steady at $341.00 an ounce in line with the European trends and rose in lira terms to 1,490,700 lira per gram from Thursday's 1,482,600 lira.
Dealers said a liquidity shortage in the money market ahead of the weekend also depressed demand.
The Turkish currency firmed to 135,420 against the dollar from 135,590 at Thursday's close as the dollar strengthened in world markets.
Most of the day's trade -- 532 kilos -- took place in the morning session, with 77 percent of total trade in lira terms.
